summary: Bound allowedLoss(p)·log p by terms indexed by (c, r) ∈ [1, x₁] × {0,1,2,3} with p ∈ {N, mc − 1, c, mc + 1}, of size 3fa(log b)²·(log-term)·2/c; the harmonic sum ∑_{c ≤ x₁} 1/c ≤ 1 + log x₁ and size comparisons give ≤ fa(log b)³.

steps.claim: log x₁ > 0, and ∑_{c ≤ x₁} 1/c ≤ 1 + log x₁ (harmonic sum).
steps.lean:
obtain := (HasLogBound.pos D : 0 < D.logX₁).le, D.hasLogUpper_of_le_of_nonneg
    (log_exp _ ▸ harmonic_eq_sum_Icc ▸ harmonic_floor_le_one_add_log D.x₁ D.le_of_hasLogBound)

steps.claim: Bound each term allowedLoss(p)·log p by the sum, over the pairs (c, r) ∈ [1, ⌊x₁⌋] × {0,1,2,3} with p = [N, mc − 1, c, mc + 1]_r, of 3fa(log b)²·(·)·2/c (shown below); regroup the total by fibers.
steps.lean:
grw [sum_le_sum fun p _ ↦ ?_, (Icc 1 ⌊D.x₁⌋₊ ×ˢ range 4).sum_fiberwise_eq_sum_filter _
    (fun (c, r) ↦ [D.N, D.m * c - 1, c, D.m * c + 1][r]!)
    (3 * D.f * D.a * D.logB ^ 2 * _ * 2 / ·.1), filter_subset]

steps.claim: The regrouped total is ≤ budget (harmonic bound, size comparison).
Unfold allowedLoss; cases: p ∈ nonsplitPrimes, p = N, other.
steps.lean: simp [allowedLoss, lt_ceil]; split_ifs with h h

steps.claim: Case p ∈ nonsplitPrimes (p < x₁ prime, χ_K(p) ≠ 1).
steps.lean:
· obtain := h.2.1.two_le, le_floor h.1.le
    rsuffices ⟨u, a, b⟩ : ∃ u ∈ @filter .., @ite .. ≤ 2 * p / Prod.fst u
    grw [loss, b, ← single_le_sum (by bound) a, h.1, log_exp, cast_div_le]; simp [field]
    split; obtain ⟨c, _⟩ | ⟨c, _⟩ := ‹_› <;> [use (c, 3); use (c, 1)] <;>
      grind [c.div_lt_iff_lt_mul, mul_le_mul_left c D.le_m]
    use (p, 2); grind [mul_div_left]

steps.claim: It suffices to find a pair (c, r) in the fiber of p with the loss factor ≤ 2p/c.
steps.lean: rsuffices ⟨u, a, b⟩ : ∃ u ∈ @filter .., @ite .. ≤ 2 * p / Prod.fst u

steps.claim: Then loss(p)·log p ≤ fa(log b)²·(a/p)·μ·log x₁ ≤ the term at (c, r).
steps.lean: grw [loss, b, ← single_le_sum (by bound) a, h.1, log_exp, cast_div_le]; simp [field]

steps.claim: If p is short (m ∣ p − 1 or m ∣ p + 1, p = mc ± 1): take (c, 3) or (c, 1); μ = m and m/p = m/(mc ± 1) ≤ 2/c.
steps.lean:
split; obtain ⟨c, _⟩ | ⟨c, _⟩ := ‹_› <;> [use (c, 3); use (c, 1)] <;>
      grind [c.div_lt_iff_lt_mul, mul_le_mul_left c D.le_m]

steps.claim: If p is not short: take (p, 2), μ = 1.
Case p = N: the term 4mfb·log N is bounded by the term at (1, 0).
The remaining size comparison and non-negativity.
